faq_heading: New construction in North Vancouver: your questions answered

faq.q: What counts as new construction on this page?
faq.a: Active MLS® listings in North Vancouver where the board's age field is 0 or less: homes finished this year and homes listed before completion, in houses, townhomes and condos.

faq.q: Where are the newest homes in North Vancouver?
faq.a: Over the past year the newest sold homes were townhomes in Pemberton NV: median build year 2022, 19 sales, median price $1,450,000.

faq.q: How fast do newer homes sell in North Vancouver?
faq.a: The quickest group among the newer ones was condos in Lynn Valley: 11 days to sell at a median, closing at 97.8% of the list price.

blocks.text: Every listing in the search above is an active MLS® listing in North Vancouver with the board's age field set to 0 or less, meaning completed this year or listed ahead of completion. Houses, townhomes and condos are included, and land and income properties are not. A lot of presale homes are sold by the developer and do not appear on the MLS® until near completion, which means the search is a part of the new-home market, not all of it.
What newer homes in North Vancouver have sold for
The most recently built homes that sold in North Vancouver from November 2025 to October 2026 were townhomes in Pemberton NV. Their median build year was 2022; 19 sold at a median of $1,450,000.
2 of 55 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later. The newest were Pemberton NV townhomes (built 2022) and Queensbury townhomes (built 2020).

items.t: Pemberton NV townhomes: 19 sold at a median of $1,450,000 (middle half between $1,128,000 and $1,535,000), taking 14 days at 97.7% of the list price, with a median build year of 2022. The typical home had 3 bedrooms, it sold for about $917 per square foot, strata fees were a median $597 a month and 11% of the sales closed over the list price.

In Lower Lonsdale, the 46 townhomes that sold had a median build year of 2019 and a median price of $1,285,000; the middle half closed between $1,178,250 and $1,478,750, after 22 days on the market at 96.8% of list. The typical home had 3 bedrooms, it sold for about $830 per square foot, strata fees were a median $635 a month and 2% of the sales closed over the list price. The median moved from $1,280,000 (November to January) to $1,220,000 (August to October).
